boss-music.name: Epic Boss Battle (Seamlessly Looping)
boss-music.creator: Juhani Junkala / SubspaceAudio

menu-music.name: RandomMind medieval loop music (menu, calm, victory beds)
menu-music.creator: RandomMind
menu-music.notes: RandomMind medieval loop set: Old Tower Inn (menu), King's Feast (calm), Rejoicing (victory). Each original OGA page licenses the full and loop versions CC0; loop Ogg conversions from ashawkey/GlyphChess. The retained upstream credits list the selected tracks; Minstrel Dance is referenced in those credits but not included.

jrpg-evil.creator: Juhani Junkala / SubspaceAudio
